kurz: If a project runs its own server on this PC – a test server or a local interface, for example – the AMW checks regularly whether it answers and restarts it if you want.
brauchst: The port the server answers on.
Optionally the command that starts it and its working folder.

schritte.text: With a start command: `amw server anmelden <name> --port <port> --start "pythonw C:/path/server.py --port 8766" --ordner C:/path --neustart`. If the server fails, the service restarts it.
Operations › Project servers shows state, failures and who is notified on failure. Check now: `amw server pruefen <name>`.

werte: port the server answers on locally
command without a window, e.g. with `pythonw`
who gets a message on failure (default: you)
fehler: The service checks in its next round; after a minute the state is shown.
Without `--neustart` and a start command the AMW only reports the failure.
danach: Unregister: `amw server abmelden <name>`. The server itself keeps running; the AMW never stops anything.
